name: Hotline Blox
desc:
THIS GAME WILL NO LONGER BE UPDATED INDEFINITELY, SO EXPECT BUGS AND STUFF



! CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS AND COLORS !
-PC SUPPORT ONLY-

a Hotline Miami inspired, fast paced, Singleplayer top down shooter

-- menus --
ARROWS  -  Change Selection
ENTER  -  Select
BACKSPACE  -  Back

-- gameplay --
WASD  -  Move
LMB  -  Attack
RMB  -  Throw
MMB  -  Lock on
SPACE  -  Execute / Interact
LSHIFT  -  Look Further
LALT  -  Roll (if available)
M  -  Pause Menu

P - Show Ping (top left)
